stories.title: Coldwater drafts rules to steer data center growth
stories.dek: Township officials heard from a consultant on how to limit building size, noise and power use. The draft ordinance would give local boards more say over where centers can locate. Residents nearby could face fewer surprise projects and clearer limits on industrial sprawl.
stories.source_title: Coldwater hears expert as it drafts data center control ordinance - Coldwater Daily Reporter

stories.title: Developer sues Michigan city over data center ban
stories.dek: A company is challenging a year-long moratorium that blocks new data center proposals. The lawsuit puts local tax incentives and land-use rules in the spotlight. A win for the developer could open the door to projects that residents have opposed on power and noise grounds.
stories.source_title: Michigan City Sued by Developer Over Yearlong Data Center Ban - Bloomberg Law News

stories.title: Bay City drafts rules to curb data center sprawl and noise
stories.dek: The proposed ordinance sets strict limits on size, sound and setbacks for any new data center in Bay City. Residents 30 miles away could see changes in power rates and water use if large projects move forward. The rules aim to protect neighborhoods before construction begins.
stories.source_title: What’s inside proposed data center ordinance for Bay City - MLive.com

stories.title: Genoa Township keeps data center freeze in place another year
stories.dek: The board voted to extend the moratorium, blocking new proposals while it studies impacts on roads, power and wells. Livingston County residents could face higher taxes or utility bills if big projects slip through later. The pause gives locals more time to weigh the trade-offs.
stories.source_title: Genoa Township Board Extends Data Center Moratorium - WHMI

stories.title: Coldwater residents get first look at data center plans and risks
stories.dek: City officials in Coldwater held an informational session to lay out what data centers could mean for local power use, water demand and tax revenue. Branch County residents now have concrete numbers on potential jobs versus infrastructure strain. The meeting comes as more developers eye southwest Michigan sites.
stories.source_title: Coldwater city officials hold informational meeting on data centers - wtvbam.com

stories.title: Coldwater Mayor Says No Interest in Data Center Over Water and Power Use
stories.dek: MSU expert told joint council meeting that consumption and property-value effects scale with facility size. Officials plan new ordinances to discourage developers.

stories.title: Kalamazoo blocks new data centers and battery plants for a full year
stories.dek: The city enacted the moratorium after residents raised alarms over noise, power strain and water use. The one-year pause gives officials time to write permanent zoning rules that could limit where these facilities can locate. Kalamazoo joins other Michigan communities trying to slow the rapid spread of large-scale data projects.
stories.source_title: Kalamazoo implements yearlong halt on data centers, battery plants amid community concerns - WZZM13.com

stories.title: Mason residents push back on data center plan at packed council meeting
stories.dek: Neighbors voiced worries about noise, traffic and electricity costs from a proposed facility near the city. The council responded by approving a public communication plan instead of moving straight to approvals. The debate shows how even smaller Michigan towns are now facing big-tech development pressure.
stories.source_title: Residents speak out against data center at Mason City Council meeting - WLNS 6 News

stories.title: Mason residents get city updates on nearby data center plans
stories.dek: Mason City Council approved a communication plan to keep residents informed about data center proposals. The move comes as opposition grows to a project near the city. Local taxpayers could see impacts on power rates and services if large facilities move forward.
stories.source_title: Mason City Council approves data center communication plan - WILX

stories.title: Mason City Council Approves Outreach Plan for Potential Data Center Projects
stories.dek: The council unanimously passed the Mason Connect plan Monday night, scheduling a Sept. 14 town hall and neighborhood meetings to update residents on any future data center proposals amid strong public opposition during comment.

stories.title: Nessel fights to close Campbell plant despite data center power needs
stories.dek: Michigan AG Dana Nessel is challenging the latest federal order keeping the Campbell coal plant running. Data centers are driving up electricity demand across the state. Keeping the plant open longer means continued emissions and costs for ratepayers.
stories.source_title: Nessel vows another challenge as DOE issues 6th order keeping Campbell plant open - Michigan Advance

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
